Fixed on 5f83a336 for both parts of the finding. (a) Copy errors: tools/deps/install-sandbox.sh:170-182 checks every `rm -rf`/`cp -a`, reports the failing destination and ends with fail (exit 1) if any copy failed; the unconditional success path of round 4 is gone. Fault injection with the unchanged installer (18-f123-copyback.log Cases C/D): a PATH shim making cp fail on the node_modules copy-back gives 'failed to copy node_modules back to ...' for each member and 'node_modules copy-back failed; the install is incomplete', exit 1; an rm shim failing on the destination gives the same, exit 1; the control run without a shim exits 0 (Case E). (b) Destinations: lines 150-168 resolve the members from pnpm-workspace.yaml on the REAL tree (root plus glob matches that have a package.json), no longer from every on-disk package.json at depth <= 4. In Case A, the yaml is identical to the committed one (packages: apps/*, packages/*). The resolver yields root, apps/a, apps/legacy and packages/b. A planted node_modules at a stray tools/x/package.json (depth 2, the round-4 hazard) and at packages/c (glob match, no package.json) is NOT copied back. create and frozen populate the root and member node_modules and write the lockfile. AC-9 PASSes in the suite (17-ac8-nondestructive-proof.log). Residual, raised separately as F-DG1-126 (Low): the resolver regex reads every YAML list item, not only `packages:`, and ignores `!` exclusions (Case B). It is not reachable with the committed yaml.

Fixed on 5f83a336. apps/api/src/architecture.testkit.ts bans the dynamic-code primitive names in every non-type syntactic form (rule 1: identifier, member, string literal, key, import/export name; 57-72, 266-274) and every computed member or computed property name whose key is not a literal or numeric by construction (rule 2: 171-178, 275-283). Re-test (22-plant-f124.log), through the candidate's fileViolations(): f["constr"+"uctor"] -> 'computed member with a non-literal key'; Reflect.get(fn, "constructor") -> 'reflection via Reflect' + 'the "constructor" key as a value'; Reflect.get(fn, "constr".concat("uctor")) -> 'reflection via Reflect'. My own probes are also caught: unicode-escaped Fun\u0063tion and .constr\u0075ctor, String.raw`constructor`, globalThis destructuring, a class computed member, Object.values(getOwnPropertyDescriptors(...)) and a k+0 key. End to end (22b-plant-f124-module-tree.log): as real files in apps/api/src/modules/access/, the R1 and R2 plants turn architecture.test.ts red (1 failed of 74, naming the file and line); without a plant the real module tree passes 74/74 with zero violations (also 07-test.log). The module-source refactors (access/rules.ts PERMISSION_CATEGORY Map; identity/routes.ts cookieValue over own cookie entries; platform/cursor.ts entries sorted by the same UTF-16 order as keys().sort(); transformations/routes.ts STATUS_TRANSITIONS and SORTS Maps, whose six keys equal the shared listQuery sort enum) behave the same for every valid input, and an invalid one is now refused rather than throwing a TypeError. The integration suite covers them: sorting and cursor pagination, OIDC cookies, status transitions; 200/200 twice (20-integration-run1/2.log). A different primitive still gets through: the native loaders, via an import of node:process. It is raised separately as F-DG1-125 (Low); the constructed-key route this finding is about is closed.
